```json
{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "glucose_risk_tier",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of plasma glucose into 4 clinically meaningful tiers: normal (<100), pre-diabetic (100-125), diabetic (126-199), severe (>=200). Higher tiers indicate greater metabolic risk.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "glucose_metabolism",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides direct ordinal splits on the most predictive single feature, allowing tree to exploit known clinical thresholds without needing to rediscover them.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas < 100, 0, np.where(plas < 126, 1, np.where(plas < 200, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_obesity_tier",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal BMI category: underweight/normal (<25=0), overweight (25-29.9=1), obese class I (30-34.9=2), obese class II+ (>=35=3). Zero mass treated as missing-like and assigned tier 0.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "body_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes nonlinear BMI thresholds as ordinal integers, enabling tree splits at clinically meaningful obesity boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mass < 25, 0, np.where(mass < 30, 1, np.where(mass < 35, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_bmi_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of plasma glucose and BMI, capturing joint metabolic burden. High values indicate co-occurring hyperglycemia and obesity.",
      "value_range": [0, 9820.8],
      "feature_family": "metabolic_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear interaction term that tree models can split on to capture combined glucose-obesity risk that neither feature alone expresses.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "plas * mass"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_pregnancy_burden",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of number of pregnancies to age, reflecting reproductive burden relative to life stage. Higher values suggest more pregnancies per year of life.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.62],
      "feature_family": "reproductive_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures age-normalized pregnancy load; tree can split on high burden thresholds that may correlate with gestational diabetes history.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "preg / (age + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of insulin to plasma glucose, approximating insulin sensitivity. Low ratio with high glucose suggests insulin resistance. Zero insulin treated as 0 ratio.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "insulin_sensitivity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes insulin resistance signal; tree splits on low ratio thresholds can identify metabolically compromised individuals.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas > 0, np.minimum(insu / (plas + 1.0), 10.0), 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_glucose_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator: 1 if plasma glucose >= 126 (diabetic threshold), 0 otherwise. Provides a direct boolean split at the clinical diabetes diagnosis boundary.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "glucose_metabolism",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Boolean feature enables a single clean split at the most clinically relevant glucose threshold, reducing tree depth needed to isolate high-risk cases.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(plas >= 126, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "obese_and_high_glucose",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean interaction: 1 if both BMI >= 30 and glucose >= 126, capturing the high-risk co-occurrence of obesity and hyperglycemia.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "metabolic_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Conjunctive boolean feature that tree models cannot easily reconstruct from individual splits alone; directly flags the highest-risk metabolic profile.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((mass >= 30) & (plas >= 126), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pedigree_log_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p-transformed diabetes pedigree function score, compressing the right-skewed distribution to improve tree split quality on genetic risk.",
      "value_range": [0.091, 0.9],
      "feature_family": "genetic_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces skew in pedigree scores so tree splits are more evenly distributed across the genetic risk spectrum rather than concentrated at low values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(pedi)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_tier",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal age bucket: young adult (21-30=0), middle-aged (31-45=1), older adult (46-60=2), senior (>60=3). Captures nonlinear age-related risk escalation.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "age_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ordinal encoding of age risk tiers allows tree to split at meaningful life-stage boundaries rather than arbitrary numeric thresholds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(age <= 30, 0, np.where(age <= 45, 1, np.where(age <= 60, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "skin_bmi_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of skin fold thickness to BMI, indicating subcutaneous fat distribution relative to overall body mass. Deviations may reflect atypical fat distribution patterns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "body_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures fat distribution pattern beyond BMI alone; tree can split on extreme ratios indicating unusual adiposity profiles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mass > 0, np.minimum(skin / (mass + 0.001), 5.0), 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic semantic score (0-4) assessing combined metabolic risk from glucose, BMI, age, and pedigree. Score increments: +1 for glucose>=126, +1 for BMI>=30, +1 for age>=45, +1 for pedigree>=0.5. Reflects multi-factor risk accumulation.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "composite_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregated risk count provides a single ordinal feature capturing multi-domain risk; tree can split at thresholds like score>=2 to identify high-risk individuals efficiently.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "blood_pressure_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of diastolic blood pressure from the training-set mean (67.9 mmHg), capturing both hypo- and hypertensive anomalies. Zero pressure values (likely missing) produce large deviations.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 54.1],
      "feature_family": "cardiovascular",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Flags abnormal blood pressure in either direction; tree splits on high deviation can isolate individuals with cardiovascular irregularities associated with metabolic disease.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(pres - 67.9)"
    }
  ]
}
```
